met_analysis:
The Well Marked low pressure area over Gangetic West Bengal & adjoining Jharkhand lies over West Jharkhand & neighbourhood at 0530 IST of today, the 02nd September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwest with height. It is likely to become low pressure area during next 12 hours. It is likely to move west-northwestwards across South Uttar Pradesh and North Madhya Pradesh during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Ferozpur, Delhi, Lucknow, centre of Well Marked low pressure area over West Jharkhand & neighbourhood, Digha and thence southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The trough now runsfromnorthwest Uttar Pradesh to northwest bay of Bengal across the cyclonic circulation associated with Well Marked low pressure area over West Jharkhand & neighbourhood and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough now runs from south Gujarat to the cyclonic circulation associated with Well Marked low pressure area over West Jharkhand & neighbourhood across north Madhya Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh between 4.5 & 5.8 Km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & adjoining Jammu Division now seen as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 30°N .
